_comment: BURN-DOWN list for the size check in checks.mjs: files already over the limit when it was added. The list may only ever shrink. The gate fails three ways: a file over the limit that is not listed here, a listed file that has grown past the number recorded for it, and a listed file that no longer needs to be listed. Never add an entry to make a red check green -- take the smallest thing in the file out into its own file instead. Every entry says what will split it and stays until that happens.

desk.html.note: The operator desk: the first screen, the queue, and a person's record in one page. Splits when the record screen becomes one screen with toggles -- the panels move out as their own modules and the page keeps the shell. Recorded 2026-09-30.

api/desk.js.note: Every desk action in one file: the first screen, the queue, the funnel, a person, and fourteen writes. Splits by subject alongside the record screen -- the plan and milestones, the quotes, and the introductions each want their own module. Recorded 2026-09-30.

test/database.test.mjs.note: Every query test in one file, grouped by subject with a console heading per group. Splits along those headings into test/db/*.test.mjs when the next group is added. Recorded 2026-09-30.
